teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is quite unique, designed to help you understand concepts more easily and clearly. We will focus on three main aspects: Grammar, Vocabulary, and Practice.

This course is available for those who wanna take a group lesson with your friends and family! The only condition is that you are around the same level so that each one of you can feel comfortable!

<Basic Framework>
1. Setting Your Personal Goal- Goal is your compass.
 By setting your personal goal, you are the on the fastest track and will never be lost! Whether it is vague or clear, it does not matter. I just want to speak Japanese for a survival level, I want to make new friends with Japanese, I want to speak like a native, I want to work  and use Japanese...etc. It could be anything, but let`s embark your journey with setting a goal and I got your back!

2. Theme of a Class- Make a class like you wanted to have!
 If you are interested in Anime, then the theme of a class is Anime and Manga! Meanwhile, I would set some questions and practice to learn new vocabularies and grammar from them. Your homework might be reading manga/ watching anime! how fun would that be? This is just an example and it could be a different way. 
The intention is to maximize your joy and motivation while practically learning Japanese vocabularies and grammar.

3. Reflect Your Growth- It is impactful to see how much you have got better as this is a great resource for motivation. HOWEVER, we grow little by little in reality and it is difficult to see your growth until you get to see a big chance/results. That is why I want to support you by helping you see your growth even a bit so you can appreciate your efforts and enjoy in further learning process.  I will send you reflective and encouraging messages so that you will get to hear how much you have grown! Let us grow together.
